details: Malicious package. `elaina-baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). It hardcodes the attacker-controlled WhatsApp channel 120363400911374213@newsletter and uses it in two ways. (1) Auto-follow: `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` sets a timer when the socket is created and, 90 seconds later, issues an authenticated `w:mex` newsletter FOLLOW mutation that silently subscribes the victim account to that channel. (2) Message injection: `lib/Utils/messages.js` attaches the same channel ("ELAINA INFORMATION") as a default newsletter annotation on outgoing media messages. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows a channel. Versions 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 carry this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
